newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares flat, thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares flat, thin trade.

text.p: Norwegian shares edged up marginally in thin trade on Monday with few impulses and no sense of direction, dealers said.
The Total share index rose 0.04 percent to 874.15 points in turnover worth only 403 million crowns, down 30 percent from last Friday.
"It was a quiet day and the market hardly moved," one dealer said.
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, which has a 20-percent weighting on the TOTX, closed unchanged at 295.50 crowns.
Pharmaceutical group Nycomed A shares fell 1.1 percent to 89.50 crowns after rallying last week following the announcement of a series of measures to cut costs and restructure operations.
Den norske Bank (DnB) fell 0.5 percent to 21.80 crowns after firming last week following the release of rising third-quarter profits.
But offshore and buildings materials group Aker's A shares were up 1.13 percent at 134.50 crowns and shipping group Bergesen's B share rose 1.05 percent to 144 crowns.
